verdict.rationale: Extend's extraction response docs say every run returns schema values plus per-field confidence scores and citations that point back to the exact spot on the page. Citations are also listed as a product feature and extend to file-level provenance in multifile extraction, which covers the core of field-level provenance for agent citation and human verification. A community developer calling Extend's bounding-box demos 'decent' gives light corroboration of location-level grounding. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that citations include page number, bounding-box coordinates and the verbatim source snippet as distinct fields; independent hands-on verification of citation accuracy.
